title: grindelia fastigiata var. revoluta
intro: Grindelia fastigiata var. revoluta, commonly known as gumweed, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the daisy family (Asteraceae). It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from respiratory issues such as bronchitis, coughs, and colds due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Grindelia fastigiata var. revoluta include soothing irritated mucous membranes and reducing inflammation in the respiratory tract. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
